issues.description: The problem statement requires the subroutine set_pixel to receive parameters in registers (x in EAX, y in EBX, RGB in ECX) and explicitly states that except for EAX no other register contents may be changed by set_pixel. However, the template contains an in-file comment that could be interpreted as a contradictory convention for saving registers when calculating the pixel position in main ("Attention: save all registers you modify except eax,ebx and esi"). This ambiguous instruction in the template conflicts with the explicit register-preservation requirement for set_pixel in the problem description and may confuse students about which registers they must preserve and which they may modify.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify and align the template comments with the problem specification: update the comment near the main TODO to state explicitly that set_pixel must preserve all registers except EAX (i.e., callers should assume EBX/ECX/ESI/etc. are preserved) and that any temporary registers used must be saved/restored by the callee. Alternatively, change the template comment to only refer to saving registers when implementing the position calculation in main (and not to set_pixel), so it does not contradict the problem requirement about set_pixel's register-preservation.
